review.imagery: Root reviewed the full phase brochure index and all8 extracted source scenes. Own-phase facade selected for the card. The bedroom, living and kitchen concepts recur across Nesba2/3 and retain collection scope. The Aljada aerial retains community scope. The phase-three park approach is included.
review.floorPlans: Root visually reviewed all14 staged complete spreads, every apartment drawing and all18 enlarged visible numeric footer panels. 13 delivered choices cover every original type, the first–ninth floors and both masters. Final visible totals were read manually, without relying on underlying PDF text.
review.location: Root reviewed the phase-specific red building footprint and the complete regional/Aljada maps. The original community map prints2/3/5/20-minute estimates to Zahia/University City/Sharjah airport/Dubai airport. Journey mode and surveyed entrance remain unknown. No coordinate or distance inferred.
review.provenance: Normal-GET original developer category and phase-specific PDF have dated source URLs, byte counts and SHA256 receipts. Source masters, original PDF and complete drawing notices remain intact. Protected identity, researched commercial text and pagination preserved.

unavailable: Exact visitor entrance, kilometre distances, live route conditions and contracted drawing revision remain unverified. Shared Nesba interior concepts do not establish a finished individual home.
